notes: The heavy weight is hidden-case generalization: the agent must ship a reusable X.509 inspection tool (inspect.py) whose RFC 4514 subject, mixed-type/absent SANs, RSA/ECDSA/Ed25519 key detection, floored day arithmetic, and dates_match comparison are all validated on fresh author-generated certificates (multi-SAN, ECDSA with fractional validity, SAN-less mismatch, multi-RDN Ed25519 with IP SAN). The visible half (openssl/cryptography cert generation with exact UTC start and an unencrypted mode-0600 matching key) adds a security/hardening component and a dependent generate-then-inspect stage, pushing the total into the medium bucket; complexity comes from the generalization/inspection contract, not prompt length.
